model: Known centered joint second moments of two bivariate instrument readouts. Cross block rows follow X_channels, columns follow Y_channels; transpose it for the YX block. No sample covariance estimation, regression intercept or data whitening by arbitrary feature units is requested.
target: Find the ordered maximum correlations between nonconstant linear combinations of X and Y, with unit variance separately within each instrument, and the leading direction family. Direction labels: within_instrument_common_level means coefficients proportional to(1,1) in BOTH original instrument coordinates; within_instrument_contrast means proportional to(1,-1) in BOTH; neither means neither family. Signs of the two canonical variates may be flipped together.

unit_change.interpretation: Change numerical units only, on the named coordinate axes. Transform all covariance and cross-covariance blocks consistently. Do not change the underlying random measurements.

provenance.data_origin: Explicitly constructed numerical instrument/reporting studies for this benchmark; not measurements from a named laboratory or archive.
provenance.method_scope: Conditional finite-dimensional linear measurement models. Scientific conclusions follow from the stated covariance/distance definitions; no distributional or causal interpretation beyond those assumptions.
